row:
Our mission is to rescue, rehabilitate, legislate, and educate until every dog has a loving and safe place to call home. We believe we can and will see an end to dog homelessness and abuse through legislative efforts, hard work, and strategic partnerships near and far. We will never give up, and we will never back down from the needs of these heartbeats. Big Dog Ranch Rescue is associated with the Weimaraner Rescue & Adoption of Florida and is a 501(c)3 non-profit organization

Learn More: https://www.bdrr.org
